description: Change the plan of a workspace that already has a subscription, to a `price_id` from list_plans. Always call it first with `confirm: false`, which for an upgrade returns a preview of the prorated charge and charges nothing, and get the user's agreement to that amount. With `confirm: true` an upgrade charges the payment method on file immediately and adds the photos at once, while a smaller plan charges nothing now and is booked to start at the next renewal. For a workspace without a subscription it returns `no_active_subscription`; use create_checkout there instead. It cannot cancel a subscription; the user does that in the app. Needs an OAuth sign-in: with an API key it returns an error pointing to the app.

confirm.description: false previews an upgrade; true applies the change.

name: change_plan
title: Change subscription plan
